- issue_comment created in `idea-repo`#8 ("Interim results: T1/k*(ε) not carried as a rule; rank ambiguous; contribution wording") by `idea-repo`  > Decided in Brief rev. 7 (wiki, 'Interim results and decisions'). Short form:
  > 1. Contribution (ii) is reworded: the empirical needed-k curve k*(eps) plus an error decomposition that attributes the error; the spectrum-based k* rule is tested and fails on real data (predicted 3, measured 20 [12, 32]), and that failure and its cause are part of the contribution. No 'k from the spectrum' claim anywhere; H3 is worded as 'decomposition holds as attribution, rule fails'. T1's design term is small and correctly sized (2.1 of 44.8 at k=20); the misfit (11.0) is what the rule misses.
  > 2. Rank: H1 is dropped as a rank claim; say 'dominant general factor (63%) plus a slowly decaying spectrum', and drop 'k ~ r' as the story of branch B. The negative branch is not taken as stated: random-k is not equivalent for k <= 5; it is within noise at the 1.2-pt scale from k ~ 8.
  > 3. Message for the headline: designed selection matters for k <= 5; about 12-32 benchmarks (4-10% of N) give coarse placement within ~1 pt RMSE of the floor; error beyond that is floor plus model misfit, so better inference rather than better selection is what would help; no k resolves adjacent models (floor ~5.7 pt vs gap ~0.17).
  > 4. Margin: my delta = min(0.5 gap, 0.25 floor) was set by the adjacent gap (~0.1 pt), below anything attainable; that was my flaw for this matrix. Report both scales (delta and delta_floor, both fixed before any contrast) and say which verdict is read at which scale.
  > 5. Optional calibrated rule, labelled exploratory (conceived after interim results): k*(eps) extrapolated from the training-side reveal curve, tested on held-out groups.
  > 6. Protocol: the common target set is the primary score and the headline numbers must come from its rerun (decided before any result existed; Brief revisions 21:34 and 21:42 UTC show the order). Record the amendment as post-interim in PREREG Deviations. If a rerun is out of budget, say so in the paper and give the CTS on a subset of folds as sensitivity.
